subject.title: fix(sandbox): make materialized sandbox-skills directory writable to support agent autonomous uninstallation

question: Should sandboxed agents be allowed to mutate the generated materialized skill view directly, or should autonomous uninstall use an owner-managed refresh after deleting the canonical workspace skill?
rationale: The correct choice determines whether the materialized directory remains an immutable isolation artifact or becomes sandbox-writable state; source and upgrade contracts must be checked before changing that boundary.

options.title: Preserve read-only materialization
options.body: Keep the generated view read-only and add or document a controlled refresh path after canonical skill removal.

options.title: Permit targeted materialized writes
options.body: Allow writes only if maintainers explicitly define synchronization, validation, and rebuild semantics for the generated view.

recommendation.title: Preserve read-only materialization
recommendation.body: Keep the generated view read-only and add or document a controlled refresh path after canonical skill removal.

likelyOwner.reason: No verified source-history owner could be established from the available read-only evidence.
